# ArchiveOptions

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Mutable archive opening options. Open snapshots them; later changes do not affect the reader.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#reading-archives-400).

## Format

`ArchiveOptions.Format: STRING`

Writable instance property.

Empty selects automatic detection; otherwise specify a supported format name.

## MaxEntries

`ArchiveOptions.MaxEntries: INTEGER`

Writable instance property.

Positive processing limits, capped at 64 MiB per entry, 256 MiB total and 100,000 entries. Zero or negative values report ErrCode.Invalid, values above the cap ErrCode.Limit; the setting stays unchanged.

## MaxEntryBytes

`ArchiveOptions.MaxEntryBytes: LONG`

Writable instance property.

Positive processing limits, capped at 64 MiB per entry, 256 MiB total and 100,000 entries. Zero or negative values report ErrCode.Invalid, values above the cap ErrCode.Limit; the setting stays unchanged.

## MaxTotalBytes

`ArchiveOptions.MaxTotalBytes: LONG`

Writable instance property.

Positive processing limits, capped at 64 MiB per entry, 256 MiB total and 100,000 entries. Zero or negative values report ErrCode.Invalid, values above the cap ErrCode.Limit; the setting stays unchanged.

## Password

`ArchiveOptions.Password: PASSWORD`

Writable instance property.

Optional archive password. Encrypted headers may require it even to list members.
